description: This PHP source file defines the MailingSubController class within the Goteo CMS, specifically for managing email marketing functions such as sending bulk emails, managing templates, filtering recipients, and handling mailing logs in the admin panel.

classes.name: MailingSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing mailing operations such as composing, sending, listing, copying, and viewing details of mailings within the admin section of the Goteo application.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to access mailing functionalities based on node configuration and user roles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with configuration data, loads interests, statuses, methods, types, roles, templates, languages, and date ranges for filtering mailings.

methods.name: sendAction
methods.description: Handles sending bulk emails by saving mail data, managing recipients, creating logs, and redirecting to the mailing detail view.

methods.name: detailAction
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific mailing sender including recipient count and content.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Displays the mailing editing form, retrieving recipients and previous session data.

methods.name: receiverAction
methods.description: Adds or removes recipients from the mailing session based on user interaction.

methods.name: get_template_contentAction
methods.description: Fetches the content of a specific email template in a given language.

methods.name: copyAction
methods.description: Duplicates an existing email (mail) record to prefill the mailing form for editing or resending.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays the list of mailing templates and available filters.

methods.name: getReceiversText
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of the current recipient filters.

methods.name: getReceivers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of potential recipients based on applied filters for mailing.
